name: Minette
source: Human-shaped automata created by Mise Altoise. She was sleeping in the tower of the Cathedral when Leicester found her, and she awoke thanks to a massive meteor of Ale. Her core is the Anima Perla, a powerful Artifact capable of pacifying Ale monsters. Child-like and innocent, she is like the group's mascot: she likes everyone and is liked by everyone. She particularly likes Leicester, whom she calls "papa".
